description: This file contains methods for dumping and retrieving database schema information, including table structures, indexes, collations, and options, specifically for PostgreSQL within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: SqlStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL store with methods to retrieve schema information.

methods.name: GetSchemaDefinition
methods.description: Dumps the entire database schema including tables, indexes, collations, and options.

methods.name: getDatabaseCollation
methods.description: Retrieves the database collation setting for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: getDatabaseEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the database encoding setting for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: getTableOptions
methods.description: Retrieves table-specific options from PostgreSQL system catalogs.

methods.name: getTableSchemaInformation
methods.description: Retrieves table and column metadata from information_schema.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for all tables from pg_indexes.
